formula.placement_score: urgency_weight * 1000 / (region.latency_ms + 1), rounded to 6 decimal places; higher is better
formula.eligibility: region.health == healthy AND region.latency_ms <= latency_limit_ms AND region.compliance_level >= institution.required_compliance_level
formula.effective_used_bytes: region.used_bytes + sum(bytes of active assigned objects)
formula.weighted_latency_satisfaction: 100 * sum(urgency_weight of active objects whose assigned region meets latency_limit) / sum(urgency_weight of all active objects)
